summary: Final-year Applied Computer Science (IT & Business) student at AP Hogeschool Antwerpen, focused on data engineering. I’ve worked with Power BI, SQL and SAP/ERP, and I was scrum master on a team-built client QA dashboard.
about: I study Applied Computer Science in the IT & Business programme at AP Hogeschool Antwerpen, where I’m in my final year. The programme combines software development with how businesses run their processes and data.
What interests me most is how data reaches a report: where it comes from, how it is checked, and how it ends up in front of the people who use it. That is why I’m focusing on data engineering.
